mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_pay (order_id, pay_user_id, out_trade_no, pay_channel, pay_amount, biz_type, qr_code_url, status, expire_at, create_time, update_time , tenant_id) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{payUserId}, #{outTradeNo}, #{channel}, #{amount}, #{bizType}, NULL, 'unpaid', DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE), NOW(), NOW() , #{tid})
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_pay SET status = 'paid', paid_at = #{paidAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status != 'paid'
UPDATE trade_pay SET status = 'refunded', update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 'paid'
UPDATE trade_pay SET status = 'paid', paid_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status != 'paid'
mapper.select: SELECT pay_id, order_id, out_trade_no, pay_channel, pay_amount, qr_code_url, status, paid_at, expire_at, create_time, update_time FROM trade_pay WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_pay (order_id, biz_type, out_trade_no, pay_channel, pay_amount, qr_code_url, status, expire_at, create_time, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (NULL, 'renew', #{outTradeNo}, #{channel}, #{amount}, #{qrCodeUrl}, 'unpaid', DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE), NOW(), NOW(), #{tid})
